name: deposit and evaporate a shared trail
mechanism: many agents build solutions step by step choosing components with probability rising with a shared per-component trail value; good solutions deposit trail on their components and all trail evaporates each round, so the population's history biases future construction

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Ant colony optimization' in section Computational mathematics / Optimization algorithms:

fails_when: stagnation on one trail; rates decide everything
